title: Tally by JieGou — does the report you're about to send match your data?
excerpt: Independently recompute every figure in a spreadsheet or report from its source rows — or tie it out against QuickBooks — with the exact rows as proof.
content_html:
Does the report you're about to send
actually match your data?

Drop it here and find out — every figure re-added from the rows underneath, right now, in your browser.

orConnect your Google Sheet— Tally re-checks it on a schedule and alerts you when it stops tying out.

🔒 Your spreadsheet never leaves your browser. Everything here runs on your device.

How it fits your workflow

Check. Watch. Prove.

CheckBefore you hit send

Reviewed isn't reconciled. Drop a file — or connect a Google Sheet — and every figure is independently recomputed and reconciled against its own rows, marked ✓ or ✗, with the exact rows as the receipt.

WatchThen stop thinking about it

Tally re-pulls a connected sheet daily or weekly, re-verifies every figure unattended, and tells you the moment something stops tying out — or the data changes under a number you already reported. Set up a watch →

ProveSo they stop re-checking you

Every verification becomes a shareable “✓ Verified” link. The person you send it to clicks any figure and sees the rows behind it — proof, not promises.

See it catch a real mistake

A landscaping business's monthly numbers

GreenEdge tracks jobs on one tab and shows the owner a revenue-by-crew summary on another. This month, one figure doesn't tie out.

1 The sheet their job log

2 The report revenue by crew

3 Tally's check …

One crew's total is overstated by $3,450 — a job counted twice. Caught before it reached anyone. The mistake is genuinely in the file, not staged.

Now live

Tie your sheet out against QuickBooks

The harder question: does your report actually agree with your books? Connect QuickBooks and Tally reconciles every figure in your report against your actual invoices — credit memos included — and names the ones that don't tie, with the exact documents as proof. It reads your books read-only and keeps no copy.

Connect QuickBooks →

Not ready to connect? Get occasional product updates by email as we add sources.

content_html_zh:
您要发送的报告实际上与您的数据相符吗？

将其放在此处并查找 - 现在，在您的浏览器中从下面的行中重新添加了每个数字。

或者连接您的 Google 表格 — Tally 会按计划重新检查它，并在它停止使用时提醒您。

🔒 Your spreadsheet never leaves your browser. Everything here runs on your device.

它如何适合您的工作流程

查看。 手表。 证明。

在点击发送之前检查

经审查不同意。 拖放一个文件，或者连接一个 Google 表格，每个数字都会根据自己的行进行独立重新计算和核对，标记为 ✓ 或 ✗，并以确切的行作为收据。

观看然后停止思考

Tally 每天或每周重新拉出连接表，在无人值守的情况下重新验证​​每个数字，并在某些内容停止绑定时告诉您 - 或者您已经报告的数字下的数据发生变化。 设置手表 →

证明他们不再重新检查你

每次验证都会成为可共享的“✓ 已验证”链接。 你发送给它的人点击任何数字，就会看到它后面的行——证据，而不是承诺。

看看它发现了一个真正的错误

园林绿化企业的月度数据

GreenEdge 在一个选项卡上跟踪工作情况，并在另一个选项卡上向所有者显示按船员划分的收入摘要。 这个月，有一个数字不相符。

1 他们的工作日志

2 船员收入报告

3 理货检查...

一名船员的总工资被夸大了 3,450 美元——这项工作被计算了两次。 在到达任何人之前就被抓住了。 该错误确实存在于文件中，而不是上演的。

现在直播

将您的表格与 QuickBooks 绑在一起

更难的问题是：你的报告实际上与你的书相符吗？ Connect QuickBooks 和 Tally 可以将报告中的每个数字与实际发票（包括贷项凭证）进行核对，并列出不相符的数字，并以确切的文件作为证据。 它以只读方式读取您的书籍，并且不保留任何副本。

连接 QuickBooks →

还没有准备好连接吗？ 当我们添加来源时，通过电子邮件偶尔获取产品更新。
